fields.name: source_id
fields.description: Approved authority identity; mirrors APPROVED_STORE_OPENING_SOURCES in apps/data_platform/store_opening.py. An identity outside the allowlist is quarantined, never accepted as authority.

fields.name: snapshot_id
fields.description: Immutable source snapshot id (intake.source_snapshots.source_snapshot_id). Replay identity: corrections arrive as a new snapshot, never as an in-place edit.

fields.name: tenant_id
fields.description: Owning tenant id (core.tenants.tenant_id). The backfill engine rejects any record whose tenant differs from the run tenant.

fields.name: store_id
fields.description: Canonical store id (core.stores.store_id) the opening date is asserted for.

fields.name: opened_on
fields.description: First day of real commercial operation, ISO 8601 date. Never derived from created_at, ingestion time, or any record-keeping timestamp.

fields.name: authority_type
fields.description: Kind of authority behind opened_on, e.g. AUDITED_MERCHANT_RECORD / APPROVED_GOVERNMENT_REGISTRY / REGULATORY_FILING / POS_FIRST_TRADING_DAY. Open vocabulary: the engine defaults it and intake.store_opening_authority_lineage.authority_type persists it NOT NULL.

fields.name: provenance_note
fields.description: System of record plus record locator behind the claim.

fields.name: inferred_from_created_at
fields.description: Self-declared inference flag. Only false is admissible: a record that admits opened_on was inferred from created_at is quarantined.

fields.name: created_at
fields.description: Upstream record-creation timestamp, carried for provenance only. It is never an opening-date source; the engine rejects records whose opened_on merely restates it.
